name: cosmos
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Cosmos instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Cosmos tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Cosmos through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Cosmos Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Cosmos only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
